verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no data on fanless/thin designs or battery-life testing; instead it documents a configurable TDP of 45-120W (docs-5) which is a high-power envelope more associated with performance laptops/desktops than thin-and-light or fanless machines, and community discussion centers on a 'Framework Desktop' form factor (comm-6/7/8) plus an explicit complaint that AMD hasn't focused on reducing power usage (comm-5). No vendor or independent source cites battery-life numbers or fanless SKUs.
